correctness.rationale: For arbitrary k, Johnson Eberlein top-sector coefficients are (-1)^i binom(k,i), and the graph-distance permutation i->min(2i,2(k-i)+1) gives exactly the coefficients of (1+(-1)^k z)(1-z^2)^k. Even-weight Walsh characters in the antipodal quotient have Krawtchouk generating polynomial (1-z)^j(1+z)^(2k+1-j) and j=k+(k mod 2) makes these coefficients identical. The k=3 centered spectra are explicit with multiplicities summing to 34/63; g(p)=3(3^p-2^p)-1 is strictly increasing and the other centered branches remain negative until its unique root; positive after the root disproves CND. Endpoint ranks follow from strictly negative multiplicities. Independent checker built the graphs, BFS matrices, spectral tests, exact coefficient identities k=2..25.
